caveat: Counts passive native seat journals kept as one hardlink per execution. Entry names are local labels from a trusted collector, not authentication; the read-only archive may be a shared plain directory. closed_full_roster counts rows only: closed with no trailing partial line, and every declared seat has run_enter and a play_end with an explicit disposition. A null or ended_unknown play_end, a trailing partial line, pending_header and open are unknown, never an outcome. No grade, reward or pass is read or implied. expected_executions exists only for finished jobs whose completed trials equal registered trials.
